versions.changelog:
instagram-publisher 1.0.0

- Initial release: publish photos, carousels, and Reels to Instagram Business or Creator accounts.
- Supports post scheduling and media uploads (images or videos, including carousels and Reels).
- All media is re-hosted to public URLs for Instagram compatibility.
- No local API keys needed; authentication via secure MCP Connector link.
- Includes detailed error handling and account management guidance.
- Requires an Instagram Business/Creator account and setup via boring.aiagent-me.com.
